company.shortDescription: Ahli Bank is a joint stock firm that engages in commercial banking operations such as retail banking, corporate banking, and other services
company.description: AHLI BANK SAOG offers products and services related to commercial banking. The bank is divided into two operating segments: retail banking and wholesale banking, which includes treasury and investment banking. Retail banking includes customer deposits, consumer loans, overdrafts, credit cards, and fund transfer facilities. Wholesale banking also includes deposits, including current accounts, term deposits, loans, advances, and institutional customers. It also includes loans, advances, and loans to individuals.
